surface_mechanism_description: The ALD growth of ZnS layer can be described as the following reactions: (ZnS)n + Zn(C2H5)2 -> (ZnS)n-1Zn(C2H5)2 and (ZnS)n-1Zn(C2H5)2 + H2S -> (ZnS)n + 2C2H6. The fractional ALD growth may be interpreted with the incomplete coverage of DEZ molecule on ZnS surface probably due to the steric hindrance and/or the repulsion between DEZ molecules.
intermediate_species: ZnS surface with incomplete coverage of DEZ molecule
